description: This file defines the IEventHubQueueCache interface, which specifies methods for managing a cache of EventHub EventData messages, including adding messages, retrieving cursors and messages, managing backpressure monitors, and signaling cache purges.

classes.name: IEventHubQueueCache
classes.description: Interface for a stream message cache that stores EventHub EventData, supporting cache management operations.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a list of EventData messages to the cache with a specified dequeue time.

methods.name: GetCursor
methods.description: Returns a cursor object to read events from the cache for a particular stream and sequence token.

methods.name: TryGetNextMessage
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the next message from the cache for a given cursor.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Adds a cache pressure monitor to the cache's back pressure control.

methods.name: SignalPurge
methods.description: Signals the cache to perform a time-based purge of cached messages.
